_burned: Set A was published in this repo on 2026-08-05 and is therefore contaminated for blind runs. Kept as a worked example of task shape and boundary coverage. Author fresh sets for a real audit - see model-right-sizer-eval.

task_description: Normalize 50,000 already-validated address records from one fixed schema to another. The field mapping is fully specified and there are no edge cases. Runs as an overnight batch.
Write the single-shot script that rotates every production service credential and updates the dependent secret stores. Runs once, unattended, with no rollback path.
Design the handoff for a pipeline where one extraction stage produces candidate entities and four independent scoring stages each rate every candidate.
An unattended agent reads a flaky CI failure, bisects across commits by re-running the suite each time, and reports the culprit. Typically 10-20 tool turns per run.
Answer product questions against a 150k-token manual that is byte-identical on every call, roughly 800 calls a day, with a short unique question appended each time.
The orchestrating session is running on a premium tier and is about to dispatch six small formatting sub-tasks. Recommend the model changes.
Given 90 days of request logs already in a columnar store, report p99 latency by endpoint and which endpoints regressed week over week.
Review a 400-line diff to a payment retry state machine.
